statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-3449 affects AbortSignal handling in once(). The consumer in this image (http-proxy-agent@5.0.0) calls once(socket, 'connect') without passing an AbortSignal option, so the vulnerable code path is never exercised. Upstream has already removed this dependency on main; it will be eliminated in the next kubeflow release.
